subject: Shiny Library Install on Centos Failure

messages.author: d48c25039d976859
messages.subject: Shiny Library Install on Centos Failure
parts:
I'm trying install Shiny on a Centos box. I open a shell type su and type my password and all goes well. I copy and paste the following

sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny')\""

on the next line and get this output.

R version 3.2.2 (2015-08-14) -- "Fire Safety"

  Natural language support but running in an English locale

'help.start()' for an HTML browser interface to help.
Type 'q()' to quit R.

> install.packages('shiny', repos='https://cran.rstudio.com/')
Installing package into ‘/usr/lib64/R/library’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning: unable to access index for repository https://cran.rstudio.com/src/contrib
Warning message:
package ‘shiny’ is not available (for R version 3.2.2)




I shut my firewall down and reran the command 

sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny')\""


and still no luck.

Any suggestions?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Library Install on Centos Failure
parts:
Can you try running this before trying to download:

options(download.file.method = "libcurl")

If install.packages("shiny", repos="https://cran.rstudio.com/") works after that, then the problem is with http vs. https. (Alternately, you could use http://cran.rstudio.com instead, if you don't mind the reduced security)

If that doesn't fix it, let us know.
